definition: a long thin stick with a line, used for catching fish
description: An animated scene on a wooden dock under a grey sky. A tall white pigeon with long eyelashes stands beside a small scruffy grey and green chick, and the chick holds a thin fishing rod with the line dropping down into the dark water. The camera looks down at the water, where rings spread from the float. A mermaid with long black hair rises out of the sea, a city skyline behind her, smiling with her eyes shut. She lifts the chick in her cupped hands and sets it gently back on the planks. The big white pigeon glares, spreads a wing over the chick and stares the mermaid down.

en.question: What is the small bird holding?

es.answer: Está sosteniendo una caña de pescar fina.
phrases: mirar con furia a la sirena
